player_card.summary: Refine a devoured calamity into a stored Pattern and release its damage and minor effect.

Choices: Refine Calamity Pattern: Ritual Time: 10 minutes; Cost: Spend one Devoured Calamity. Record its damage type, area shape, one minor effect, and Source CL until your next long rest. Maintain up to half PB Patterns, rounded up.

Release Calamity Pattern: Action; Range: 90 feet; Cost: 4 Qi and expend one Pattern. Recreate it as a 20-foot-radius sphere, 30-foot cone, 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line, or 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Choose a save appropriate to the original calamity: Dexterity, Constitution, Strength, Wisdom, or Charisma. Failed Save: 6d8 recorded damage and the recorded minor effect until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: half damage and no additional effect.

Great Pattern: If the consumed Calamity was Great, damage becomes 8d8, increase one area dimension by 50 percent, and the minor effect may last until the end of your next turn. Releasing this Pattern costs 6 Qi.
Limits: Available at CL 10.

A reproduced Pattern is your feature. It does not keep the original creator’s item properties, once-per-use effects, permanent consequences, or Secret authority unless this variant explicitly allows them.

Cultivation Level 18 — Walking Tribulation

Bonus Action  
Duration: 1 minute  
Cost: 8 Qi  
Limit: Once per scene

You become a mobile convergence of preserved calamities.

When activated, gain three overflow Calamity Charges. These Charges:

- May exceed your normal maximum.
- May be any types you choose from calamities you have previously survived.
- Disappear when the transformation ends.

For the duration:

- Gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.
- Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from environmental hazards and cultivation techniques.
- You may gain Calamity Charges twice per round when they come from different triggering events.
- Spending one Charge grants two different normal or typed benefits.
- Furnace Response costs 1 Charge instead of 2 once per round.
- Tribulation Release costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- Tribulation Release may originate from any point within 30 feet of you.

Calamity Aura

A hostile creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when it:

- Enters a space within 15 feet of you for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn within 15 feet of you.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Choose one damage type represented by a Charge you currently possess.

Failed Save:

- 3d8 selected damage.
- Apply one associated Calamity rider from Tribulation Release.

Successful Save:

- Half damage.
- No rider.

Heaven Strikes Twice

Once during the activation, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your Tribulation Release, force it to repeat the saving throw.

It must use the new result.

This is not a reroll granted by luck. It is a second descending wave of the stored tribulation.

Vessel Breaks Before the Calamity

If Walking Tribulation ends while you have four or more unspent overflow or normal Charges:

- Take 1d8 Force damage per unspent Charge beyond three.
- This damage cannot be reduced by Tribulation Vessel features.

All overflow Charges then disappear.

Normal Charges remain, up to your normal maximum.

player_card.summary: Reduce one component of a harmful event and devour its danger to gain a Calamity.

Effect: Trigger: You or a creature within 15 feet is affected by a qualifying harmful technique, hazard, forced movement, condition, or damage packet. Choose one component: one damage type, forced movement, condition, CP loss, or environmental hazard effect.

Reduce damage by 3d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier; reduce forced movement by 20 feet; add PB to one save against the condition or resource loss; or grant Resistance against one environmental damage event.

If you prevent at least half the selected component or turn a failed save into success, gain one Devoured Calamity of the appropriate type. Record one associated effect such as Prone, Reaction denial, Fire, teleport suppression, pressure, fear, or CP loss. One event grants one Calamity unless it is a Great Calamity.
Consume the Price: Once per turn when activating a Qi-powered feature, spend one Devoured Calamity and choose two different benefits below.
Choices: Add 1d8 associated damage.
Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice PB.
Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Increase forced movement by 10 feet.
Move your Domain Armament 20 feet.
Add PB to a Cultivation Check.
Apply the recorded minor effect to one damaged target until the start of your next turn.
Limits: Available at CL 3. A minor effect at this level cannot impose Stunned, complete cultivation suppression, instant death, or a permanent effect.

Real Danger Doctrine: You may consume a willing or self-created calamity only when the normal cost is paid, damage and consequences are real, the event can defeat, injure, scar, or meaningfully set you back, and the resulting Calamity cannot fully refund the event through a closed loop.

tianxia.subpath.qi.calamity_devouring_tr.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 — Eat the Heavenly Decree

Reaction  
You can use this when  A visible or sensed harmful effect within 90 feet begins resolving.  
Cost: 5 Qi and one Devoured Calamity  
Limit: Once per round

Choose one target, area, Anchor, or active effect component.

Make a Cultivation Check against the source’s effect DC.

Success against Lower Source CL

Choose one:

- Negate the effect against one target.
- Remove one condition or rider from all targets.
- Reduce the area’s damage to 0 for one round.
- Prevent Cultivation Point loss.
- End one persistent zone, field, or calamity component.
- Transfer the effect’s center to yourself or a legal point within 30 feet.

Gain one Devoured Calamity recording the eaten component.

Success against Equal Source CL

Choose one:

- Halve the damage and duration.
- Negate the effect against one target.
- Suppress one persistent component until the start of your next turn.
- Redirect forced movement or the effect center by up to 20 feet.

Gain one Devoured Calamity.

Success against Higher Source CL

- Reduce damage by 5d10 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to one target’s saving throw.
- Delay one rider until the end of the current turn.

You do not gain the higher Calamity unless you personally suffer at least part of it.

Failed Check

The original effect resolves.

You still take 3d10 Force or Lightning damage as the decree burns through your furnace.

This damage cannot be reduced by this variant.

Forbidden Appetite

You may use Eat the Heavenly Decree on:

- A breakthrough tribulation.
- A sect-protecting weather catastrophe.
- A curse sentence.
- An artifact eruption.
- A Formation collapse.
- A hostile Path or Secret effect.

Doing so may transfer karmic, legal, spiritual, or heavenly attention to you. Those consequences are real but not automatically represented by a Daemonic tag.

---

player_card.summary: Choose to take, divide, or swallow part of a hostile calamity aimed at another creature.

Effect: Trigger: A creature within 60 feet becomes the target, center, or designated bearer of a hostile field, curse-like calamity, tribulation strike, environmental sentence, or breakthrough backlash. Choose one option below.
If you survive or successfully resolve the transferred event, gain one Devoured Calamity; a Great Calamity may grant two.

Heavenly Aggro: For the scene, count as a willing substitute for a formal tribulation targeting a consenting ally if you stay within 60 feet, the tribulation’s own Source Rule does not prohibit substitution, and the ally explicitly accepts. Acceptance by the tribulation is not guaranteed; if authority is contested, make a Cultivation Check against its operating DC.
Choices: Take the Target: If the feature can legally affect you, become the target or center. Move up to 15 feet toward the original target without provoking Opportunity Attacks and resolve the event against you; the original target is unaffected by the transferred component.
Divide the Calamity: Split one damage packet, forced movement, condition duration, or CP loss equally between you and the target. Round damage against you up.
Swallow the Rider: The original target resolves damage normally, but you receive one associated condition, forced movement, resource loss, or printed additional effect instead.
Limits: Available at CL 6.

Cultivation Level 14 — Hundred-Step Saber Procession

Action  
Cost: 6 Qi  
Movement: Up to twice your Speed  
Limit: Once per turn

Move along a legal path up to twice your Speed.

During this movement:

- You do not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- You may move through hostile creature spaces as Difficult Terrain.
- You may cross liquids, unstable surfaces, and open-air gaps no longer than 20 feet.
- You cannot pass through solid barriers, Total Cover, sealed Formations, or spaces too small for you.
- You must end in a legal unoccupied space.

Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus in different hostile creatures whose spaces you pass within your saber’s reach.

Make one saber-family weapon attack or Saber Domain Armament Attack against each chosen creature.

Resolve attacks separately.

Procession Damage

Each hit deals normal weapon or Domain Armament damage.

The first hit during the Procession deals an additional 3d8 Slashing or Force damage.

Each later hit deals an additional 2d8 damage.

Once-per-turn features apply only once across the Procession unless expressly stated otherwise.

Procession Technique Delivery

You may deliver one authorized weapon-delivered cultivation technique through the first qualifying hit.

For each additional hit through which you want to deliver the same technique:

- Spend 1 additional Qi.
- The target must be a legal target.
- Resolve its attack or save normally.
- Do not repay the technique’s base cost.
- Pay any target-specific material or permanent cost.
- A once-per-activation rider still applies once.
- A once-per-target rider may apply to each target.
- The technique cannot generate another Procession, attack sequence, or recursive copy.

This feature expressly permits one cultivation technique to be delivered through multiple attacks when its additional costs are paid.

Momentum of the Procession

After the Procession resolves:

- Gain 1 Gale Momentum for each different hostile creature hit.
- You cannot exceed your maximum.
- Choose one creature hit and push it 10 feet or knock it Prone if it is no more than one size larger than you.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin.player_text:
Cultivation Level 14 — No Fixed Compass

Your soul can continue a direction even when the body is constrained by ordinary geometry.

Direction Without Footing

Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

While completing a declared Bearing, you may move across liquid, narrow surfaces, unstable terrain, vertical surfaces, and open gaps as though they were stable ground. You fall at the end of the turn unless you reach a supporting space or another rule keeps you aloft. This is a spiritual step, not flight.

Nonmagical Difficult Terrain does not cost you extra movement while completing a Bearing.

Break the Restraining Direction

Once on each of your turns when a Grappled, Restrained, pinned, tethered, or similar effect prevents movement required by your declared Bearing, you may spend 2 Resonance and make a Cultivation Check against the effect's escape DC or Source Rule.

- Success: End one ordinary Grappled or Restrained effect on yourself, or suppress one equal-authority movement restriction until the end of the turn. You may then continue moving.
- Failure: The restriction remains. You do not spend movement that the restriction made illegal, but you cannot attempt this procedure against the same effect again during the turn.
- Higher authority: On success, suppress only the expression preventing the current movement unless the effect's own rules permit complete escape.

Bearing Without Name

Once per turn when you spend a Bearing token, you may treat it as either of the other two Bearings for one printed rider. The movement you already performed is not rewritten; only the rider changes.

Soul Splitting — Counter-Needle

While your Soul Fragment is within 60 feet of your Pole:

- you may originate Turn the Compass or Break the Four Directions from yourself or the fragment, chosen when activated;
- range, line of effect, and movement are measured from the chosen origin;
- you remain the only attacker and mover unless the feature expressly moves the fragment;
- after you spend a Bearing token, the fragment may move 10 feet without an action at the end of the activation.

Once per turn after that movement, if the fragment ends within 10 feet of your Resonance Marked Pole, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on the Pole until the start of your next turn.

The fragment cannot generate Bearing tokens, complete Bearings for you, or use Break the Four Directions independently.

Cultivation Level 18 — Hundred Echoes Kill One Moment

You manifest every combat-ready version of your position across a single decisive interval.

Bonus Action  
Cost: 10 Resonance  
Duration: 1 minute  
Concentration: Required

You enter the Hundred-Echo State.

Echo Field

At the start and end of each of your turns, record your current space as an Echo Position without counting against your normal limit. These State-created positions last until the State ends.

You can move through hostile creatures’ spaces, ignore nonmagical Difficult Terrain, and do not provoke Opportunity Attacks. You cannot end movement in an occupied space.

One Soul, Many Edges

Once on each of your turns when you use Mind Spike, make a weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with, or activate a single-target Spirit Awakening technique, choose up to three Echo Positions within 60 feet.

After the triggering effect resolves, choose one creature legal from each selected position. Each chosen creature takes 2d8 Psychic or Force damage. A creature chosen multiple times takes damage only once, but if it is your Pursuit Mark target, it takes 4d8 instead.

This is secondary echo damage, not additional attacks and not additional technique activations.

Moment of the Final Edge

Once during the State, use an Action to choose one creature within 120 feet that you can perceive or that bears your Pursuit Mark. Select up to six Echo Positions that form a legal sequence ending adjacent to or within 30 feet of the target, depending on your chosen final attack.

Move through the sequence by spiritual step, then choose one:

- make one weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with;
- use Mind Spike with maximum damage on its damage dice on a failed save;
- make one Cultivation Attack dealing 10d10 Psychic, Force, Slashing, or Necrotic damage on a hit.

On a hit or failed save, the target also makes a Charisma saving throw.

Failed Save: Choose two: no Reactions until the end of your next turn; Speed 0 until the start of its next turn; cannot regain Hit Points until the start of its next turn; one active lower-Source-CL movement or concealment effect ends; it is knocked Prone; it is moved 20 feet to a legal space along your echo sequence.

Successful Save: Choose one of those effects until the start of its next turn.

If the target’s Source CL is at least 5 lower than yours and it bears your Pursuit Mark, ordinary non-Secret escape, invisibility, and movement defenses cannot prevent the final approach. Equal or higher authority contests normally.

After the Last Echo

When the State ends, remove every Echo Position and Pursuit Mark you created. You cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn as your body and soul agree on which position survived.

---

Once your soul has learned a target’s combat rhythm, escape becomes another recorded position.

Pursuit Mark

When you damage a Resonance Marked meaningful hostile creature, you may spend 2 Resonance to convert your Resonance Mark on it into a Pursuit Mark lasting for the scene.

- A Pursuit Mark is a special Resonance Mark.
- You can maintain one Pursuit Mark at a time.
- You know the marked creature’s direction and approximate distance while it remains within 1 mile and is not behind stronger concealment.

- move to an Echo Position within 60 feet and use Mind Spike against the target if it is legal from that position;

Your soul fragment can maintain one Echo Position of its own. You may use that position as an origin for Strike From the Echo or Three-Step Soul Execution, but doing so destroys the fragment after the technique resolves. Destruction this way does not cause the core Soul Splitting backlash damage.

Cultivation Level 6 — Exact Counterweight

You can spend a stored Measure to reduce a matching consequence before it is finalized.

Reaction  
You can use this when  You or a willing creature bearing your Resonance Mark within 30 feet is affected by a hostile activation matching a Measure you hold  
Cost: 2 Resonance and the matching Measure

Choose the corresponding procedure.

Impact Counterweight

Reduce one instance of triggering damage by 3d8 + Wisdom modifier after Resistance and before Temporary Hit Points.

If this reduces the damage to 0, the source takes Psychic damage equal to your Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus and becomes Resonance Marked until the end of your next turn, provided it is a creature within 60 feet that you can perceive or spiritually locate through your mark.

Impact Counterweight does not reduce Hit Point costs, self-inflicted sacrifice, maximum-Hit-Point reduction, Exhaustion, cultivation harm, or damage that expressly cannot be reduced unless you win the relevant authority contest.

Motion Counterweight

Choose one:

- reduce forced movement by up to 20 feet;
- prevent the target from being knocked Prone;
- grant Advantage on the triggering check or save against becoming Grappled or Restrained;
- if the effect imposed Grappled or Restrained without a check or save, make a Cultivation Check against its Source Rule. On a success, suppress that condition until the start of the protected creature's next turn.

If all forced movement is prevented or the protected creature avoids the condition, it may move 5 feet to a legal space without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the source.

Intent Counterweight

If the trigger allows an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, add 1d6 to the roll after seeing the d20 but before the outcome is finalized.

If the trigger imposed an ordinary lower-Source-CL effect without a save, make a Cultivation Check against its Source Rule. On a success, suppress one mental, emotional, spiritual, possession, command, or identity expression until the start of the protected creature's next turn.

If the added die changes a failure into a success or the suppression succeeds, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on the source until the start of your next turn if it is within 60 feet and can be affected by spiritual authority.

No Borrowing from the Same Blow

A Measure gained from a hostile activation becomes available only after that activation and every linked damage packet, movement, condition, and rider have resolved. It cannot pay for Exact Counterweight against the activation that created it.

The Bond Refuses

Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC or Source CL.

Higher, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation, true-name, conceptual, reincarnation, or campaign-scale authority: On success, suppress one printed expression until the end of the scene and learn the proper reconstruction route. The complete consequence is not erased automatically.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.miko.feature.ka.player_text:
Cultivation Level 18 — Kami Descent

A willing greater kami or perfected shrine office descends into your cultivated spirit. This is negotiated hosting, not uncontrolled possession.

Bonus Action  
Cost: 10 Resonance and 1 Offering  
Duration: The scene  
Concentration: No

Choose one Descent Aspect appropriate to your shrine or covenant. You gain the universal benefits and the chosen Aspect.

Universal Benefits

- +2 AC.
- Choose one Descent Movement when the covenant is recorded: Heavenly Flight (Fly 60 feet and hover), Sacred Ascent (Climb 60 feet, including ceilings), River Passage (Swim 60 feet and breathe air and water), or Processional Step (walking Speed becomes 60 feet and you ignore nonmagical Difficult Terrain and liquid surfaces). Kami Descent grants the recorded movement.
- Advantage on saving throws against possession, curses, Frightened, Charmed, and spiritual contamination.
- Ordinary and lower-Source-CL spirits recognize the manifest kami authority and cannot disguise their broad Nature from your Spiritual Sense.
- Your Brief Purification and Minor Kami Favors can originate from you, your Soul Fragment, your Shrine Anchor, or your Manifest Messenger, but each activation still uses only one origin.

Descent of Purity

Once per turn when you spend Resonance on a Miko or Spirit Awakening feature, one willing creature affected by that feature regains Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier or repeats one save against possession, curse, poison, disease, Frightened, or spiritual contamination.

Once during the Descent, use Kami Purification as an Action without additional Resonance or Offering cost. Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures within 60 feet. Each chosen creature selects one benefit: end one ordinary Charmed or Frightened condition; repeat one saving throw against possession, curse, dream intrusion, memory alteration, Spiritual Affliction, or Heart Demon influence with Advantage; return its displaced soul to its body if both are within 60 feet and no equal-or-higher-authority seal prevents return; or suppress one equal-or-higher-Source-CL Spiritual Affliction until the end of the scene if you succeed on a Cultivation Check against its save DC. Kami Purification grants no hostile damage, soul destruction, planar expulsion, or Anchor damage.

Descent of Protection

You and allies within 20 feet gain Resistance to Psychic and Necrotic damage. Once per round when an ally in that aura takes damage, use your Reaction and spend 1 Resonance to reduce the damage by 2d10 + Wisdom modifier.

Once during the Descent, create Sacred Ground without an Offering or Resonance cost. It lasts only until the Descent ends and uses no destructible Anchor; it is centered on you and moves with you.

Descent of Revelation

Your Spiritual Sense becomes 120 feet and can perceive through ordinary walls up to 5 feet thick for the limited purpose of detecting spirits, souls, possession, curses, dream intrusion, spiritual Assets, and sacred or profane Anchors. Total cover still prevents ordinary targeting.

Once during the Descent, ask the descending kami three questions concerning the current site, spiritual conflict, local history, or an entity the kami can perceive. The kami answers truthfully according to its knowledge and Nature.

Descent of Renewal

At the start of each of your turns, one willing creature you can perceive within 30 feet regains Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier if it has at least 1 Hit Point.

Once during the Descent, touch one creature and restore 8d8 + Wisdom modifier Hit Points, end one ordinary poison or disease, and suppress one curse, possession, Heart Demon, or spiritual contamination for the scene. Equal or higher authority requires a Cultivation Check.

Reciprocity and Taboo

When Kami Descent ends, the kami withdraws. If you upheld its Nature and Taboo, no automatic Exhaustion is gained.

If you knowingly violate the recorded Taboo during the Descent, apply the recorded Taboo Consequence immediately: one of the four consequences below must have been selected when the Shrine Covenant was created.

- Gain 1 level of Exhaustion.
- Your Soul Anchor becomes Strained until you complete the recorded Restitution.
- Lose access to one recorded Minor Kami Favor until you complete the recorded Restitution.
- Your Shrine Anchor and Manifest Messenger become unavailable until you complete the recorded Restitution.

The covenant also records one Restitution from the Procedure Addendum. The consequence cannot be changed after the breach and the GM or AI does not invent a harsher replacement during resolution.

A kami cannot use Descent to seize control of the character without a separate hostile possession procedure and saving throw. You remain the acting character.

Domain Integration

If Domain Manifestation is active when you use Kami Descent, your Domain becomes recognized sacred territory for the duration. Sacred Ground effects you create inside it use the Domain’s boundary if smaller, and willing spirits inside can communicate through spiritual impression even without a shared language.

Failed Save: The creature gains your Hourglass Mark. This is a special Resonance Mark. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the mark on a success.

Successful Save: It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect until the start of your next turn.

You can maintain only one Hourglass Mark. Because it is one of your Resonance Marks, applying it replaces another Resonance Mark you placed on that creature, and applying an ordinary Resonance Mark to that creature replaces the Hourglass Mark unless this feature expressly says otherwise. Creating a new Hourglass Mark ends the previous one.

While the mark lasts, once per round when the marked creature begins one of the following activities, you may spend 1 Resonance and gain 1 Time Debt to apply the corresponding delay.

Delayed Movement

When it begins voluntary movement, reduce the distance available to that movement by 15 feet, minimum 0. If this prevents it from reaching a required destination, an action requiring that arrival must be redirected to another legal target or fails under its normal rules.

Delayed Strike

When it makes an attack roll, subtract 1d6 from the roll. Decide after seeing the d20 but before the outcome is finalized.

Delayed Technique

When it forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw against a technique, choose one target. That target adds 1d6 to its saving throw. This cannot modify an environmental or passive save whose source is no longer the marked creature.

Delayed Reaction

When it attempts a Reaction, the Reaction occurs only after the triggering action, movement, or technique fully resolves. If the trigger is no longer valid at that time, the Reaction does not occur and any resource committed specifically to that Reaction is not spent.

You cannot apply more than one Hourglass delay to the same roll, movement, technique, or Reaction.

Break the Glass

The marked creature or a creature adjacent to it can use an Action to strike, shatter, dispel, exorcise, or spiritually realign the mark.

The acting creature makes one of the following checks against your Cultivation Save DC:

- Intelligence (Arcana);
- Wisdom (Insight);
- Dexterity (Sleight of Hand);
- a Cultivation Check using an appropriate Source Rule.

On a success, the Hourglass Mark ends. Time, Fate, Spirit, Clock, Sound, anti-curse, and suitable conceptual severance effects can qualify.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.player_text:
Cultivation Level 3 — Speak with the Dead

You can awaken corpse memory or lingering residue without importing a spell’s fixed assumptions.

Ritual: 1 minute  
Range: Touch  
Cost: 1 Resonance

Choose a corpse with an intact head, chest, or other body part that retains a memory-bearing organ or a funerary object linked to the deceased, funerary object, grave marker, severed body part containing meaningful residue, or location where a creature died within the last year.

Ask up to 1 + half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, questions. The response comes through voice, gesture, corpse movement, remembered sensation, nearby shadows, written condensation, or another appropriate medium.

What the Dead Know

The residue can answer only from information the creature knew, perceived, believed, or experienced before death. It may be confused, biased, incomplete, or emotionally distorted. It does not know what occurred after death unless the lingering spirit remained present.

Resistance and Protection

The corpse or residue can resist if:

- The creature was hostile to you.
- Its funeral rites prohibit questioning.
- Its soul or memory is sealed.
- Another authority claims custody.
- It died under Secret, divine, artifact, or higher-Source-CL concealment.

Make a Cultivation Check against the protecting effect or the creature’s Charisma save bonus converted into a DC of 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Charisma modifier. On failure, you learn whether the resistance is unwillingness, ignorance, damage, concealment, or higher custody.

Repeat Questioning

Once you use Speak with the Dead on a given residue, you cannot question the same residue again until you learn materially new information, repair it, obtain consent, or a new scene begins. Repetition cannot force a different answer through dice fishing.

Funerary Reading

Gain proficiency in Medicine or Religion. If already proficient in both, gain proficiency in Investigation or Insight instead.

- The Bone Guard is a manifested Body Asset, not a Complete Soul, Companion, independent character, corpse, or harvestable supply of permanent bone. Creating another causes the existing Guard to disappear.
- It occupies a Medium space. It has no ability scores or proficiencies beyond what its printed statistics require. “Uses your saving-throw modifiers” means use the numerical modifier shown on your character record for the called save; it gains no separate save proficiency.
- The Guard can move normally during its turn. When you command Attack, it may move and make one Bone Strike. Dash, Disengage, Dodge, and Help use the corresponding action and allow ordinary movement. Move lets it move up to its Speed and take no action. Guard lets it move and prepare Guard the Sovereign.
- Issuing the command costs your Bonus Action. The source prints no command distance, so no additional distance limit is imposed while you and the Guard are on the same plane and no effect blocks your direct cultivation control.
- Without a command, it takes Dodge and, if possible, uses movement to remain within 30 feet of you. It does not independently choose attacks or tactics.
- Guard the Sovereign is the Bone Guard's Reaction, usable once per round. Declare after a legal protected creature is targeted but before the attack roll. The Guard must be within 5 feet of that creature at that moment.
- Bone Strike is a cultivation attack made by the Guard using your Cultivation Attack Modifier. The Guard is the attack's origin, but you remain the controlling Source Rule for Source CL and feature attribution. It cannot deliver your personal hit riders unless a feature expressly permits it.
- Ordinary creature healing does not restore the Guard unless the healing rule can target a Body Asset. At 0 Hit Points it disappears with no transferable remains, materials, or injury to you.

player_card.summary: Use a Soul Anchor as the defining spiritual root that keeps your awakened self coherent.

Effect: Every Spirit Awakener has a Soul Anchor under the universal Soul Anchor rules. It may be a true name, vow, ancestor, grief, dream, mask, mirror, companion spirit, shrine, debt, lost home, forbidden memory, heart demon, unfinished death or another defining spiritual root.

At Cultivation Level 1, record its name or description; whether primarily internal, relational, locational, embodied, object-linked or vow-linked; one way you normally commune with it during a Full Cultivation Session; and any separate physical vessel, relationship or location representing it.
Your Soul Anchor is a legal focus for Spirit Awakening techniques when a Source Rule permits a spiritual focus.
A Strained Soul Anchor does not erase Path features, but can prevent an expressly printed Anchor Invocation and affect techniques that explicitly depend on it.
Realm Suppression does not remove its existence, though it can suppress higher-CL expressions depending on it.
Limits: The recorded description creates no destructible object, Companion, Cultivation Asset, immunity, weakness or additional ability unless another Source Rule says so.
A Soul Anchor is not automatically a physical object and cannot be attacked unless a Source Rule gives it an external manifestation or Anchor profile. Ordinary damage cannot destroy it.
Severing, rewriting, consuming or permanently replacing it requires an explicit high-authority Source Rule and an explicit recovery or reconstruction procedure.

A Spirit Companion, ancestor, shrine, object, relationship or vow used as a Soul Anchor is not automatically a full Companion, Cultivation Asset or destructible Spiritual Anchor; those statuses need separate rules.

tianxia.path.spirit_awakening.feature.so.player_text:
Soul Anchors

Every Spirit Awakener has a Soul Anchor under the universal Soul Anchor rules. It describes what keeps the awakened self coherent: a true name, vow, ancestor, grief, dream, mask, mirror, companion spirit, shrine, debt, lost home, forbidden memory, heart demon, unfinished death, or another defining spiritual root.

At Cultivation Level 1, record:

- the Anchor’s name or description;
- whether it is primarily internal, relational, locational, embodied, object-linked, or vow-linked;
- one way the cultivator normally communes with it during a Full Cultivation Session;
- any separate physical vessel, relationship, or location that represents it.

These entries describe the Anchor. They do not create a destructible object, Companion, Cultivation Asset, immunity, weakness, or additional ability unless another Source Rule says so.

Path interactions:

- Your Soul Anchor is a legal focus for Spirit Awakening techniques when a Source Rule permits a spiritual focus.
- A Soul Anchor is not automatically a physical object and cannot be attacked unless a Source Rule gives it an external manifestation or Anchor profile.
- A Strained Soul Anchor does not erase your Path features, but it can prevent an expressly printed Anchor Invocation and can affect techniques that explicitly depend on it.
- Ordinary damage cannot destroy a Soul Anchor.
- Severing, rewriting, consuming, or permanently replacing a Soul Anchor requires an explicit high-authority Source Rule and an explicit recovery or reconstruction procedure.
- Realm Suppression does not remove the existence of a Soul Anchor, though it can suppress higher-CL expressions that depend on it.

A Spirit Companion, ancestor, shrine, object, relationship, or vow used as a Soul Anchor is not automatically a full Companion, Cultivation Asset, or destructible Spiritual Anchor. Those statuses require separate rules.

player_card.summary: Create a Personal Domain around you to support allies and exert spiritual authority.

Effect: Area: 30-foot aura centered on you. Record the sensory expression of the spiritual truth seeded by your Soul Anchor and refined through your Subpath when you gain this feature; that description adds no effect.
The Domain moves with you. A creature is affected while inside; entering does not itself trigger a saving throw unless a Source Rule says so.

Anchored Allies: Allies of your choice inside gain Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom and Charisma saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, coercive Hosting, dream intrusion, memory alteration, emotional domination and soul displacement. At the start of your turn, you may revise which willing creatures count as allies without an action. You cannot designate an unwilling hostile creature as an ally merely to bypass its protection or Bond terms.
Unfading Marks: Your Resonance Marks on creatures inside do not expire from duration. A mark ends normally when the creature leaves the Domain, the Domain ends, or another effect removes it.

Domain Pressure: Once on each of your turns, when a creature inside fails a saving throw against your Spirit Awakening Path or Subpath feature, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect without additional cost. This occurs only once during the turn regardless of the activation’s failed saves, targets, echoes or origins.

Revealed Spirits: Inside, Spiritual Sense detects ordinary invisible spirits, possession links, Hosted entities, projected souls, Soul Fragments and lower-Source-CL spiritual disguises without a check. Equal- or higher-authority concealment remains contested.
Subpath Domain Expression: A Subpath may add an expression that modifies this one Domain; it creates no second Domain, aura, turn or Concentration slot unless it explicitly says otherwise.

Domain Collision: Compatible Domains coexist. For contradictory laws on the same target, space, Bond, route or effect, compare Source CL; equal Source CL uses a Cultivation Check contest. Losing suppresses only the contradictory expression unless a Source Rule expressly makes the whole Domain collapse.
At CL20, the radius becomes 60 feet and activation costs 4 Resonance.
Limits: Available at CL15.
The Domain ends if you are Incapacitated, willingly end it, leave the scene, cannot manifest Path features, or a Source Rule suppresses or breaks it.
It is not automatically a Spiritual Anchor, prison, anti-teleport field, sanctuary, spirit court, Companion command zone or law over every soul inside.

player_card.summary: Use Spiritual Exorcism to diagnose, suppress, separate, expel, cleanse and release invasive spiritual effects.

Effect: Use the terms and authority hierarchy in the Spirit Awakening Rules Reference.

Eligible Intrusions: unwilling possession or coercive Hosting; dream intrusion; spiritual contamination; imposed emotional corruption; memory interference; hostile spirit presence; a Heart Demon expression whose Source Rule permits another creature to confront it; a curse with a spiritual, dream, memory, emotion, identity or soul component; or Charmed, Frightened or madness from a supernatural mental or spiritual source.

Exorcism DC: Make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the Intrusion’s save DC. If no printed DC, use its creator’s or sustaining spirit’s Cultivation Save DC. If neither is available, use the fallback Authority DC for its Source Realm.
Fallback Authority DC: Mortal 12; Foundation 14; Core Formation 16; Nascent Soul 18; Immortal 20.

Failed Check: Battlefield Exorcism leaves the Intrusion in place; if it permits a repeat saving throw, the affected creature immediately repeats it with Advantage. Learn its broad category, Source CL band relative to you, and whether a creature, Bond, vessel, location or other Spiritual Anchor sustains it. Deep Exorcism Rite neither removes nor suppresses the effect; learn its broad category, exact Source CL band relative to you, sustaining Anchor category and one printed condition needed to meaningfully change it. You cannot repeat the rite against that effect until it changes, the revealed condition is met or your effective Spirit Awakening CL increases.
Successful Check: Compare the effect’s Source CL with this feature’s Source CL and use the corresponding result below.
A willing Host may waive resistance made on its behalf. A willing Intruder does not resist separation. If both Host and Intruder oppose, use the higher relevant DC.
If an effect has no severity stages, reducing one stage removes one separately printed escalation, additional effect or consequence. If none exists, use the suppression result instead.

When complete removal is impossible, still provide the printed lesser result and diagnostic information. The central Cultivation Insight Exorcist’s Calling grants a limited earlier version and improves when you gain Spiritual Exorcism.
Choices: Battlefield Exorcism: Action; Range: 60 feet; Cost: 4 Resonance; Target: One perceived Intrusion attached to a creature, object, location, manifestation, vessel, or Spiritual Anchor. Make the Cultivation Check; your Battlefield Exorcism can target a specific Intrusion only once per round.

Battlefield Exorcism — 6 or more Source CL lower: End one ordinary temporary Intrusion. An ordinary possession is separated and locally expelled to its legal manifestation, vessel, or nearest legal space until the end of the scene. If it has no legal external state, it becomes a visible spiritual outline occupying the Host’s space without controlling the Host. A persistent, permanent, Secret, artifact, divine, or expressly Anchored Intrusion is instead suppressed until the end of the scene and reveals one printed release or reconstruction requirement.

Battlefield Exorcism — 3–5 Source CL lower: Suppress the Intrusion until the end of the scene without Concentration. The affected creature immediately repeats one save allowed by the Intrusion with Advantage; on a success, an ordinary temporary Intrusion ends. A possessing Intruder is exposed and cannot control the Host during suppression.

Battlefield Exorcism — Within 2 Source CL: Suppress the Intrusion until the end of the affected creature’s next turn. It immediately repeats one save allowed by the Intrusion with Advantage. If it has no repeat save, suppression is the complete battlefield result.

CL13 — Spiritual Exorcism

You can diagnose, suppress, separate, expel, cleanse, and release invasive spiritual effects. Spiritual Exorcism uses the terms and authority hierarchy in the Spirit Awakening Rules Reference.

An Intrusion for this feature can be:

- unwilling possession or coercive Hosting;
- dream intrusion;
- spiritual contamination;
- imposed emotional corruption;
- memory interference;
- hostile spirit presence;
- a Heart Demon expression that its Source Rule permits another creature to confront;
- a curse with a spiritual, dream, memory, emotion, identity, or soul component;
- a Charmed, Frightened, or madness effect created by a supernatural mental or spiritual source.

Spiritual Exorcism cannot treat integrated spirit ancestry, a legal Path or Subpath, a Foundation, Method, Origin Insight, ordinary memory, willing stable Bond, chosen oath, or accepted presence as an Intrusion unless its own Source Rule expressly permits separation.

Exorcism DC

Make a Spirit Awakening Cultivation Check against the Intrusion’s save DC. If it has no printed DC, use the creator’s or sustaining spirit’s Cultivation Save DC. If neither is available, use:

| Source Realm | Authority DC |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 12 |
| Foundation | 14 |
| Core Formation | 16 |
| Nascent Soul | 18 |
| Immortal | 20 |

Use an action.
Range: 60 feet

Make the Cultivation Check. A specific Intrusion can be targeted by your Battlefield Exorcism only once per round.

You learn the Intrusion’s broad category, Source CL band relative to you, and whether it is sustained by a creature, Bond, vessel, location, or other Spiritual Anchor.

Successful Check: Compare the Intrusion’s Source CL with this feature’s Source CL.

| Intrusion Authority | Result |
|---|---|
| 6 or more Source CL lower | End one ordinary temporary Intrusion. An ordinary possession is separated and locally expelled to its legal manifestation, vessel, or nearest legal space until the end of the scene. If it has no legal external state, it becomes a visible spiritual outline occupying the Host’s space without controlling the Host. The affected creature immediately repeats one save allowed by the Intrusion with Advantage; on a success, an ordinary temporary Intrusion ends. A possessing Intruder is exposed and cannot control the Host during suppression. |

A willing Host may waive resistance made on its behalf. A willing Intruder does not resist separation. When Host and Intruder both oppose separation, use the higher relevant DC.

Deep Exorcism Rite

Time: 10 minutes 
Range: Touch, or a willing Soul Vessel imprint as described by Soul Vessel 
Cost: 6 Resonance, plus 2 for a remote Soul Vessel rite 
Target: One perceived Intrusion or Spiritual Affliction

Make the Cultivation Check.

Failed Check: Do not remove or suppress the effect. Learn its broad category, exact Source CL band relative to you, sustaining Anchor category, and one printed condition required to meaningfully change it. You cannot repeat the rite against that effect until the effect changes, the revealed condition is met, or your effective Spirit Awakening CL increases.

Successful Check: Compare Source CL.

| Intrusion Authority | Result |
|---|---|
| 6 or more Source CL lower | End one ordinary temporary or persistent Spiritual Affliction. Separate an ordinary possessing Intruder into its legal manifestation, vessel, or nearest legal space; it cannot re-enter the same Host until the Host completes a Full Cultivation Session. A permanent, Secret, artifact, divine, Immortal, or world-law effect is removed only when its Source Rule permits; otherwise reduce its severity by one stage and reveal its exact remaining recovery procedure. |

Reduce one persistent Spiritual Affliction by one stage, then suppress any remainder until the target completes a Full Cultivation Session. A possession is separated for the same duration into its legal manifestation, vessel, nearest legal space, or—if none exists—a visible spiritual outline occupying the Host’s space without controlling the Host. |
| Within 2 Source CL | Choose one: reduce the effect by one printed severity stage; or suppress it until the target completes a Full Cultivation Session. Reveal its sustaining Anchor and exact printed recovery, release, confrontation, restitution, or reconstruction requirement. |
| 3 or more Source CL higher | You cannot remove or reduce it. Stabilize the target so the effect cannot increase in severity until the target completes a Full Cultivation Session, and reveal its sustaining Anchor category and exact printed requirement for the next meaningful intervention. |

If an effect has no severity stages, “reduce by one stage” means remove one separately printed escalation, rider, or consequence. If none exists, use the suppression result instead.

Effect: Choose Challenge, Pursuit, Guard or Break and spend 1–3 Credence. State the subject and exact completion condition before moving or rolling.

Hit: Deal the attack’s normal damage plus 3d8 + 1d8 per Credence spent Psychic or Force damage, then apply the matching completion below.

Pursuit: Attack the named hostile creature. On a hit, move to a legal space adjacent to it after damage. Until the start of your next turn, its voluntary movement away from you costs 2 feet for every 1 foot moved.

Guard: Attack one hostile creature that threatened, targeted, damaged, moved, restrained or spiritually affected the named protected subject during the current or previous round. On a hit, choose the declared willing subject within 30 feet. It gains Temporary HP equal to 2 × PB + Wisdom modifier, may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and gains Advantage on its next Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma saving throw before the start of your next turn.

Break: Attack the named creature, Asset, external Anchor, barrier, object or source maintaining the named effect. On a hit, make a Cultivation Check against one ongoing effect, Concentration source, Asset, external Anchor or barrier damaged by the attack. Success: end an ordinary lower-authority effect, suppress one equal-authority expression until the end of your next turn, or deal an additional 2d8 Force damage to an Asset, Anchor or object. Higher authority yields only the printed contest result.
If another effect removes the target after activation and makes the declaration impossible, you may redirect the attack to another legal hostile creature within reach, but gain no declaration rider.
Limits: Available at CL 10. Requires at least 1 Credence. Movement cannot cross illegal spaces or escape restraint without a successful contest.

player_card.summary: Bind a marked hostile creature to its chosen Intent on a failed save.

Effect: Use when a meaningful hostile creature bearing your Resonance Mark begins its turn within 60 feet. It makes a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Learn whether its first significant present intention is primarily an attack, movement, technique or Asset activation, defense or recovery, or escape. It may freely change its plan. Impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect until the start of its next turn.

Failure: Before further actions, the target chooses an Intent below that it can presently attempt and any named subject; you learn that choice. It may instead take no Action and make no voluntary movement.
Before an incompatible act, the target chooses whether to abandon it before movement, attack rolls, saving throws or limited resources are committed, or proceed and suffer Contradiction.

Contradiction: The target takes 3d8 Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. An incompatible attack has Disadvantage; targets have Advantage on saves against an incompatible technique; incompatible voluntary movement costs 2 feet for every 1 foot moved.
After Contradiction resolves, the Intent ends and the target may act normally for the rest of the turn. Contradiction occurs at most once per activation.
Choices: Strike Intent: The target names one creature or object it can perceive. Its first hostile attack or single-target hostile technique this turn must include that subject if it remains legal.
Advance Intent: It names one creature, object or space it can perceive. Before voluntarily moving farther from that subject, it must move at least 10 feet and end at least 5 feet closer.

Withdraw Intent: It names one creature or object it can perceive. Its first voluntary movement must end at least 5 feet farther from that subject; it cannot voluntarily move closer before completing that movement.

Invoke Intent: Its first Action or Bonus Action must activate a technique, item property, Cultivation Asset command, Domain, recovery feature or other supernatural Source Rule rather than make an ordinary weapon attack.
Hold Intent: It cannot voluntarily move more than 5 feet from its starting space before taking Dodge, Ready, Help, Search or another primarily defensive or observational action.
Limits: Available at CL 6. This cannot force a creature to spend a limited resource, attack an ally, enter a hazard, reveal a secret technique or take an action it cannot legally take.
